quest.minecraft:nether_star.title: &5Wither Star&r
quest.minecraft:nether_star.quest_desc: The &5Wither Star&r drops from the &cWither&r, summoned by placing 4 &8Soul Sand&r in a T-shape and topping it with 3 &fWither Skeleton Skulls&r.

quest.5FCA7209EF8CB54B.title: &aFungal Woods&r
quest.5FCA7209EF8CB54B.quest_desc: Explore the &cCrimson&r and &dWarped&r forests of the Nether.
Harvest &cCrimson&r and &dWarped&r stems for &6building&r, and gather &eShroomlights&r for decorative lighting.
&7Tip: &fHoglins&r flee from &dWarped Fungi&r, and &cPiglins&r are hostile in the &dWarped Forest&r.

quest.1000000000000028.quest_desc: Mine &8Basalt&r, &cBlackstone&r and &8Gilded Blackstone&r from the &eBasalt Deltas&r and &eBastions&r.

quest.1000000000000031.quest_desc: Collect &6Nether Gold&r, &cNetherite Scrap&r and &dAncient Debris&r from the deeps.
&dAncient Debris&r spawns between &fY=8&r and &fY=22&r — use &eTNT chains&r or &bBeds&r to reveal it.

quest.1000000000000040.title: &5Tourist&r
quest.1000000000000040.quest_desc: &aBring an &fElytra&r or &fEnder Pearls&r — gaps over lava are unforgiving.
quest.1000000000000050.title: &cNether Fortress&r
quest.1000000000000050.quest_desc: Locate a &cNether Fortress&r — the only natural source of &7Wither Skeletons&r and &eBlaze Rods&r.

quest.3FAF5DE432E71EBF.title: &6Bastion Raider&r

&aWear at least one piece of &6Gold&r armor to avoid hostility.
quest.1000000000000093.title: &6Lava Walker&r
quest.1000000000000093.quest_desc: Mount a &eStrider&r and ride it across a lava lake.

quest.1000000000000300.title: &5Towers of Hell&r
quest.1000000000000300.quest_desc: Discover the &7three Nether towers&r added by &eStructory&r:
Each holds &6unique loot&r and dangerous &cmobs&r. Climb to the top for the best chests.
quest.minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull.qu: &8Wither Skeletons&r drop their skull with a &c~2.5% chance&r per kill.
&aLooting III&r boosts the drop rate to &e~5.5%&r — bring an enchanted sword.

quest.minecraft:flint_and_steel.title: &cThe Nether Call&r
quest.minecraft:flint_and_steel.quest_de: Build a &5Nether Portal&r (minimum &f4x5 Obsidian&r frame) and light it with &eFlint and Steel&r.
&aEnter the Nether&r to begin your descent into hell.
&7Bring &fGold armor&r, &fFire Resistance potions&r and &fObsidian&r in case your portal breaks.
